e.title: insurance-causal-policy
e.summary: SDID 因果政策评估（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.2）：Synthetic Difference-in-Differences 费率干预评估
e.summary_en: SDID causal policy evaluation (burning-cost, PyPI 0.2.2): synthetic difference-in-differences for rate interventions
e.summary_hk: SDID 因果政策評估（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.2）：Synthetic Difference-in-Differences 費率干預評估
e.body: insurance-causal-policy（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.2）用 Synthetic Difference-in-Differences（SDID）评估费率政策干预的因果效应：事件研究、对照组合成——费率变更前后对比的严谨化。对 RIAA：费率政策变化的效果评估是精算日常（新费率上线后效果如何？）——[[insurance-causal]] 家族的政策评估分支；SDID 结合 DID 与合成控制（Arkhangelsky et al. 2021）；与 [[insurance-rdd]]（断点回归）、[[insurance-uplift]]（HTE）配套；适合定价决策的效果验证。
e.body_en: insurance-causal-policy (burning-cost, PyPI v0.2.2) uses Synthetic Difference-in-Differences (SDID) to evaluate the causal effect of rate policy interventions: event studies, synthetic control groups — rigorous before/after comparison of rate changes. For RIAA: evaluating the effect of rate policy changes is daily actuarial work (how did the new rate perform?) — the policy-evaluation branch of the [[insurance-causal]] family; SDID combines DID and synthetic control (Arkhangelsky et al. 2021); pairs with [[insurance-rdd]] (regression discontinuity) and [[insurance-uplift]] (HTE); suits effect validation of pricing decisions.
e.body_hk: insurance-causal-policy（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.2）用 Synthetic Difference-in-Differences（SDID）評估費率政策干預的因果效應：事件研究、對照組合成——費率變更前後對比的嚴謹化。對 RIAA：費率政策變化的效果評估是精算日常（新費率上線後效果如何？）——[[insurance-causal]] 家族的政策評估分支；SDID 結合 DID 與合成控制（Arkhangelsky et al. 2021）；與 [[insurance-rdd]]（斷點迴歸）、[[insurance-uplift]]（HTE）配套；適合定價決策的效果驗證。
